# Mapps Creation

> Wholesale trader and distributor of Lycra, knitted and polyester-lycra fabrics for garment manufacturers and exporters across India, based in Surat, Gujarat.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.mappscreation.in/): Overview of Mapps Creation's fabric supply, sourcing model and how to order.
- [About](https://www.mappscreation.in/about): Company background, founder Pratham Aggarwal, and sourcing/quality process in Surat.
- [Fabric Catalogue](https://www.mappscreation.in/catalogue): Browsable catalogue of knitted fabrics with GSM and indicative rates per kg.
- [T-Shirt Fabric](https://www.mappscreation.in/fabrics/t-shirt-fabric): Knitted t-shirt fabric qualities with GSM and indicative rates per kg.
- [Bottomwear Fabric](https://www.mappscreation.in/fabrics/bottomwear-fabric): Knitted bottomwear (lower) fabric qualities with GSM and indicative rates per kg.
- [Co-ord Set Fabric](https://www.mappscreation.in/fabrics/co-ord-set-fabric): Knitted co-ord set fabric qualities with GSM and indicative rates per kg.
- [Wholesale Partner Program](https://www.mappscreation.in/wholesale): How to register as a wholesale buyer, order process and dispatch terms.
- [Contact](https://www.mappscreation.in/contact): WhatsApp, phone and enquiry form for fabric requirements.
- [FAQ](https://www.mappscreation.in/faq): Answers on MOQ, pricing, payment, GST billing, and dispatch coverage.

## Optional
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.mappscreation.in/privacy): How enquiry-form and WhatsApp data is collected and used.
